$schema: Forensic visual parity audit (2026-08-04) -- versioned allowlist for bolao/scripts/forensic/run_forensic_audit.mjs. The ONLY mechanism that can convert a DIVERGENT finding to FUNCTIONALLY_JUSTIFIED. Every entry is validated strictly: exact app set, approvalStatus==='approved' (pending never suppresses), expiresAt not expired, current value matches expectedValues exactly. An unused, expired, or schema-invalid entry fails the audit run (exit non-zero) -- this file cannot silently accumulate stale suppressions.

entries.condition: Total card height is a function of each app's own real internal structure (Copa: single team/score row; BR2026: matchup row + meta line; CDB2026: one .confronto-card contains 1-2 .leg rows plus an optional aggregate/classificado line) -- CDB2026 extends the same base game-card component with an additional ida/volta/agregado layer per the audit's own rule, it does not get a visually different base component. Not a token: padding/margin/border-radius/background on the card itself are compared independently and must still be IDENTICAL.
